dataset.name: UROMOL early-stage urothelial carcinoma cohort (2016)
dataset.description: Independent multicenter urothelial-bladder-cancer cohort with public gene-level bulk RNA-seq FPKM and individual progression-free follow-up.
dataset.cohort_context: The UROMOL study profiled 476 predominantly non-muscle-invasive urothelial bladder tumors collected across European clinical centers. TRACE Explorer retains the 462 participants with positive follow-up and defines an event as pathological progression to muscle-invasive (T2+) and/or metastatic disease. Fourteen zero-time censored records remain in the source audit files but are excluded from survival analysis.

metadata.library_method: Ribo-Zero total-RNA depletion, strand-specific ScriptSeq paired-end RNA-seq on Illumina HiSeq 2000; TopHat2/Bowtie2 hg19 alignment and Cuffnorm gene-level FPKM
metadata.curation_note: The pinned SDRF links one RNA profile to each source participant and directly provides progression-free time and progression-to-T2+ status. Follow-up starts at surgery of the analyzed tumor and is censored at the latest cystoscopy, cystectomy, death or discontinued follow-up. The source matrix contains 43,204 gene rows; one truncated SRXN1 row is excluded, and symbols represented by multiple Ensembl identifiers are excluded by the shared repository mapping contract. EMBL-EBI terms add no restrictions beyond data-owner rights; redistribution is disabled conservatively.

samples.sample_role: Primary or recurrent urothelial bladder tumor used for bulk RNA sequencing

expression.label: BioStudies UROMOL log2(FPKM + 1)
expression.mapping_source: GENCODE hg19 gene annotation embedded in the pinned UROMOL matrix
expression.duplicate_feature_rationale: Canonical symbols represented by multiple Ensembl identifiers are excluded rather than combined without an unambiguous gene-level rule.
expression.scale_note: TRACE Explorer validates non-negative finite source FPKM values and applies log2(FPKM + 1) after restricting the matrix to endpoint-complete participants.

endpoints.label: Progression-free survival to T2+ or metastasis
endpoints.event_definition: Pathologically verified progression to muscle-invasive (T2+) and/or metastatic disease
